mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", attr_key AS "attrKey", sort_order AS "sortOrder", attr_name AS "attrName", attr_type AS "attrType", default_value AS "defaultValue", value_kind AS "valueKind", rate_target_attr_key AS "rateTargetAttrKey", min_value AS "minValue", max_value AS "maxValue", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.attribute_definitions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY sort_order, attr_key

SELECT game_id AS "gameId", attr_key AS "attrKey", sort_order AS "sortOrder", attr_name AS "attrName", attr_type AS "attrType", default_value AS "defaultValue", value_kind AS "valueKind", rate_target_attr_key AS "rateTargetAttrKey", min_value AS "minValue", max_value AS "maxValue", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.attribute_definitions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND attr_key = #{attrKey}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.attribute_definitions (game_id, attr_key, sort_order, attr_name, attr_type, default_value, value_kind, rate_target_attr_key, min_value, max_value, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{attrKey}, #{sortOrder}, #{attrName}, #{attrType}, #{defaultValue}, #{valueKind}, #{rateTargetAttrKey}, #{minValue}, #{maxValue}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, attr_key) DO UPDATE SET sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, attr_name = EXCLUDED.attr_name, attr_type = EXCLUDED.attr_type, default_value = EXCLUDED.default_value, value_kind = EXCLUDED.value_kind, rate_target_attr_key = EXCLUDED.rate_target_attr_key, min_value = EXCLUDED.min_value, max_value = EXCLUDED.max_value, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", attr_key AS "attrKey", sort_order AS "sortOrder", attr_name AS "attrName", attr_type AS "attrType", default_value AS "defaultValue", value_kind AS "valueKind", rate_target_attr_key AS "rateTargetAttrKey", min_value AS "minValue", max_value AS "maxValue", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.attribute_definitions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, attr_key
